sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日简报《Dealbook》负责商业和政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的Dealbook峰会上现场采访几位商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯汀·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 届时，您可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日通过NYTimes.com免费直播部分精选采访，供所有人观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望您能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today, a Times investigation reveals a first-hand account from John Bolton.
sentences.zh: 今天，一项《纽约时报》的调查披露了约翰·博尔顿的第一手证词。

sentences.en: Directly linking President Trump to the quid pro quo at the center of the impeachment.
sentences.zh: 直接将特朗普总统与弹劾案核心的“利益交换”联系了起来。

sentences.en: Maggie Haberman and Mike Schmidt on what that could mean for the final phase of the Senate trial.
sentences.zh: 玛吉·哈伯曼和迈克·施密特将探讨这对参议院审判的最后阶段意味着什么。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, January 28th.
sentences.zh: 今天是1月28日，星期二。

sentences.en: Mike, Maggie, remind us when the discussion of John Bolton as a possible witness in the impeachment process starts.
sentences.zh: 迈克、玛吉，提醒我们一下，关于约翰·博尔顿作为弹劾程序潜在证人的讨论是从什么时候开始的。

sentences.en: So John Bolton left the White House in early September.
sentences.zh: 约翰·博尔顿是在9月初离开白宫的。

sentences.en: Trump said he was fired.
sentences.zh: 特朗普说他被解雇了。

sentences.en: Bolton said he resigned.
sentences.zh: 博尔顿说他辞职了。

sentences.en: A week later, we learn about the whistleblower's complaint.
sentences.zh: 一周后，我们得知了举报人的投诉。

sentences.en: And at that point, questions start to percolate.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，各种疑问开始浮现。

sentences.en: Why did Bolton resign and what does he know?
sentences.zh: 博尔顿为什么要辞职？他知道些什么？

sentences.en: And in the coming weeks, as the House impeachment investigators summon White House officials to answer questions, we start to get different slivers.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几周里，随着众议院弹劾调查人员传唤白宫官员回答问题，我们开始得到一些零星的信息。

sentences.en: Bolton's former aide, that's Fiona Hill, testified yesterday before House impeachment investigators.
sentences.zh: 博尔顿的前助手菲奥娜·希尔昨天在众议院弹劾调查人员面前作证。

sentences.en: Of Bolton's concerns.
sentences.zh: 谈到了博尔顿的担忧。

sentences.en: Bolton reportedly called Giuliani, President Trump's personal attorney, this a hand grenade.
sentences.zh: 据报道，博尔顿称特朗普总统的私人律师朱利安尼的行为是一枚“手榴弹”。

sentences.en: And preoccupations with what was going on inside the White House.
sentences.zh: 以及对白宫内部发生的事情的担忧。

sentences.en: This is something that Fiona Hill said when she was talking about John Bolton, the national former national security advisor.
sentences.zh: 这是菲奥娜·希尔在谈论前国家安全顾问约翰·博尔顿时所说的话。

sentences.en: We don't have a full picture, but we're hearing things like Bolton saying.
sentences.zh: 我们还没有全貌，但我们听到了一些类似博尔顿所说的话。

sentences.en: Basically, he said, you go and tell Eisenberg that I am not part of any drug deal that Sondland, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 基本上，他说，你去告诉艾森伯格，我不会参与桑德兰（美国驻欧盟大使）和米克·马尔瓦尼正在策划的任何“毒品交易”。

sentences.en: ambassador to the European Union, and Mick Mulvaney are cooking up.
sentences.zh: 大使和米克·马尔瓦尼正在策划的。

sentences.en: I didn't want to participate in this drug deal that these administration officials were doing.
sentences.zh: 我不想参与这些政府官员正在进行的“毒品交易”。

sentences.en: The term drug deal here refers to the Ukraine probe that they were trying to initiate.
sentences.zh: 这里的“毒品交易”一词指的是他们试图发起的针对乌克兰的调查。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that was his way of referring to this pressure campaign against Ukraine to start investigations into Democratic rivals.
sentences.zh: 这就是他指代针对乌克兰的施压运动，以启动对民主党竞争对手调查的方式。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So we're learning these different things, but we're not hearing from Bolton.
sentences.zh: 所以我们了解到了这些不同的事情，但我们没有听到博尔顿本人的说法。

sentences.en: Let me read it one more time.
sentences.zh: 让我再读一遍。

sentences.en: Ambassador Taylor recalls that Mr. Morrison told Ambassador Taylor that I told Mr. Morrison
sentences.zh: 泰勒大使回忆说，莫里森先生告诉泰勒大使，我告诉莫里森先生

sentences.en: that I conveyed this message to Mr. Yarmouk on September 1st, 2019, in connection with Vice
sentences.zh: 我已于2019年9月1日将此信息传达给亚尔穆克先生，与副

sentences.en: President...
sentences.zh: 总统有关……

sentences.en: And one of the problems with the impeachment investigation...
sentences.zh: 弹劾调查的问题之一是……

sentences.en: We got six people having four conversations in one sentence, and you just told me this is where you got your clear understanding.
sentences.zh: 我们有六个人在一句话里进行了四次对话，而你刚才告诉我这就是你获得清晰理解的来源。

sentences.en: ...was that the House was only really talking to people who were sort of outside the President's inner ring.
sentences.zh: ……众议院实际上只与那些处于总统核心圈子之外的人交谈。

sentences.en: Ambassador, you weren't on the call, were you?
sentences.zh: 大使，你当时不在通话现场，对吧？

sentences.en: You didn't listen on President Trump's call and President Lyssey's call?
sentences.zh: 你没有监听特朗普总统和利西总统的通话？

sentences.en: I did not.
sentences.zh: 我没有。

sentences.en: You've never talked with Chief of Staff Mulvaney?
sentences.zh: 你从未与幕僚长马尔瓦尼交谈过？

sentences.en: I never did.
sentences.zh: 我从来没有。

sentences.en: You never met the President?
sentences.zh: 你从未见过总统？

sentences.en: That's correct.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: This is what I can't believe, and you're their star witness.
sentences.zh: 这简直让我无法相信，而你却是他们的明星证人。

sentences.en: You're their first witness.
sentences.zh: 你是他们的第一位证人。

sentences.en: A few of the witnesses dealt with the President directly, but many of them were simply relaying what was going on inside the White House.
sentences.zh: 少数证人直接与总统打过交道，但他们中的许多人只是在转述白宫内部发生的事情。

sentences.en: So Bolton becomes an even more tantalizing figure.
sentences.zh: 所以博尔顿成了一个更令人好奇的人物。

sentences.en: He's in the center of juicy tidbits coming out of the inquiry.
sentences.zh: 他处于调查中传出的各种劲爆消息的中心。

sentences.en: He may be on poor terms with the President.
sentences.zh: 他可能与总统关系不佳。

sentences.en: It all seems to make him a perfect witness.
sentences.zh: 这一切似乎使他成为一个完美的证人。

sentences.en: He's someone who Republicans truSt.
sentences.zh: 他是共和党人信任的人。

sentences.en: He has a long history in the Republican Party, and we were hearing then that he had these concerns.
sentences.zh: 他在共和党内有很长的历史，当时我们听说他有这些担忧。

sentences.en: So what was it that he saw?
sentences.zh: 那么他到底看到了什么？

sentences.en: What was it that he could add?
sentences.zh: 他能补充什么？

sentences.en: He was in the room with the President.
sentences.zh: 他曾与总统同处一室。

sentences.en: What did the President tell him?
sentences.zh: 总统对他说了什么？

sentences.en: So Maggie, what efforts are made by House impeachment investigators to get Bolton to testify, to get him to just spill the beans?
sentences.zh: 那么玛吉，众议院弹劾调查人员为了让博尔顿作证，让他全盘托出，做了哪些努力？

sentences.en: They asked him back in, I believe it was October, to come testify voluntarily.
sentences.zh: 我想是在10月份，他们曾要求他自愿前来作证。

sentences.en: He said no, and he had been ordered by the White House not to take part.
sentences.zh: 他拒绝了，而且他之前被白宫下令不得参与。

sentences.en: But the House decided not to submit a subpoena to try to force him to testify because—
sentences.zh: 但众议院决定不发出传票来强迫他作证，因为——

sentences.en: Why not?
sentences.zh: 为什么不呢？

sentences.en: Because they were concerned that it was going to be a protracted legal battle.
sentences.zh: 因为他们担心这会演变成一场旷日持久的法律战。

sentences.en: They were very consumed with trying to wrap this all up quickly.
sentences.zh: 他们当时非常急于尽快结束这一切。

sentences.en: In hindsight, a lot of Democrats say, at least privately, they think that that was a mistake.
sentences.zh: 事后看来，许多民主党人至少私下里认为那是一个错误。

sentences.en: They think that they should have actually tried to get him to come there.
sentences.zh: 他们认为当时确实应该尝试让他过来。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So he does not end up testifying before the House.
sentences.zh: 所以他最终没有在众议院作证。

sentences.en: No, Bolton never spoke before the House and didn't indicate that he really wanted to at the time.
sentences.zh: 是的，博尔顿从未在众议院发言，当时也没有表现出他真的想这样做。

sentences.en: He just said that he would not cooperate with this request for testimony.
sentences.zh: 他只是说他不会配合这一作证要求。

sentences.en: So they sent over the articles of impeachment without having a witness like Bolton,
sentences.zh: 所以他们在没有像博尔顿这样的证人的情况下，就提交了弹劾条款，

sentences.en: somebody who had a direct conversation with the President where the withheld military aid for Ukraine was tied to the President's desires for investigations.
sentences.zh: 即没有一个与总统进行过直接对话的人，能证明对乌克兰的军事援助扣留与总统对调查的渴望有关。

sentences.en: There were just people who were speculating on motives or had heard things secondhand, but there was no one with a firsthand interaction with the President.
sentences.zh: 当时只有一些人对动机进行猜测，或者听到了二手消息，但没有人与总统有过第一手的互动。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So that brings us to November.
sentences.zh: 那么这就到了11月。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so we get to November and John Bolton is starting to make noises like, you know, he has something to say and he's willing to share it.
sentences.zh: 到了11月，约翰·博尔顿开始放出风声，说他有话要说，并且愿意分享。

sentences.en: And we learn on November 10th that one place he might be planning to share it is in a book that he's planning to write about his time in the White House.
sentences.zh: 我们在11月10日得知，他可能打算分享这些信息的一个地方，是他计划撰写的关于他在白宫任职期间的书。

sentences.en: So it was a pretty odd situation.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个相当奇怪的情况。

sentences.en: You had House investigators that wanted Bolton to talk,
sentences.zh: 众议院调查人员希望博尔顿开口，

sentences.en: Bolton sort of signaling that he has something to say.
sentences.zh: 博尔顿则暗示他有话要说。

sentences.en: And then the news that he's writing a book that you presume is going to have some Ukraine details in it.
sentences.zh: 然后传出消息说他正在写一本书，你推测里面会有一些关于乌克兰的细节。

sentences.en: So who's going to get to that information?
sentences.zh: 那么谁能得到这些信息呢？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So in this situation, what do you two do as reporters to try to figure out what he knows and maybe what he's put in this book?
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，作为记者，你们两人做了什么来试图弄清楚他知道什么，以及他可能在书中写了什么？

sentences.en: So the House inquiry is over, but there's all this secrecy around this book.
sentences.zh: 众议院的调查已经结束，但这本书周围充满了神秘感。

sentences.en: We knew it was coming.
sentences.zh: 我们知道它即将出版。

sentences.en: We had heard Simon & Schuster would be putting it out.
sentences.zh: 我们听说西蒙与舒斯特出版社将负责发行。

sentences.en: They wouldn't even confirm that.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至不愿证实这一点。

sentences.en: We were scratching around with people who might know.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在向可能知情的人打听。

sentences.en: And as we were trying to do this, Bolton then says on January 6th, after, you know, not complying with the House efforts to get him to testify,
sentences.zh: 就在我们试图这样做的时候，博尔顿在1月6日表示，在没有配合众议院让他作证的努力之后，

sentences.en: he says that he would be willing to testify in the Senate if there is a subpoena.
sentences.zh: 他说如果收到传票，他愿意在参议院作证。

sentences.en: It seemed like he was trying to do a dance where he was trying not to make Senate Republicans angry at him
sentences.zh: 他似乎在玩一种平衡游戏，试图不让参议院的共和党人对他感到愤怒，

sentences.en: when he's worked with them for years and he sort of needs them to back him as he's embarking on this post-White House life
sentences.zh: 毕竟他与他们共事多年，在他开启白宫后的生活并试图卖书时，他需要他们的支持，

sentences.en: and trying to sell a book, but also trying to look like he was doing the right thing and not just making it about the book.
sentences.zh: 但同时他也想表现得像是在做正确的事，而不只是为了书。

sentences.en: And it was really hard to decipher what his motives were.
sentences.zh: 真的很难解读他的动机是什么。

sentences.en: As reporters, there is nothing that galvanizes us like a high-profile public figure in a major story saying, I have important information, but I'm not going to tell you.
sentences.zh: 作为记者，没有什么比一个重大新闻中的高调公众人物说“我有重要信息，但我不会告诉你”更能激励我们了。

sentences.en: And he's essentially out there doing that, putting the bait for reporters to try and get to the bottom of what's in the book.
sentences.zh: 他本质上就是在这样做，抛出诱饵让记者去探究书里到底写了什么。

sentences.en: So we did what we normally do when we are handed some kind of bait, which is we continue to try to figure out what was there and what was in it
sentences.zh: 所以我们做了我们通常在被抛出诱饵时会做的事，那就是继续试图弄清楚那里有什么，里面写了什么，

sentences.en: and whether it would include some damaging information about the president or whether it would include some exculpatory information
sentences.zh: 以及它是否会包含一些关于总统的破坏性信息，或者是否会包含一些免罪信息，

sentences.en: and would be something that the president's folks could even point to and say it would help him.
sentences.zh: 甚至可能是总统的人可以指出来说这对他有帮助的东西。

sentences.en: We just, we didn't know, but we kept scratching.
sentences.zh: 我们只是不知道，但我们一直在挖掘。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: If the one great unanswered question was what Bolton knew, then the most obvious thing is to find out what is inside the book.
sentences.zh: 如果那个未解的重大问题是博尔顿知道什么，那么最显而易见的事情就是找出书里写了什么。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And we kept scratching and looking and then we found out what was in the book and it was quite damaging to the president.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在挖掘和寻找，然后我们发现了书里的内容，这对总统来说相当具有破坏性。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息，去探索《纽约时报》呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当您第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，您在应用程序中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《纽约时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果您还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载该应用程序，并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Brand new reaction this morning from a bombshell New York Times report on John Bolton's upcoming book.
sentences.zh: 今天早上，关于约翰·博尔顿即将出版的新书，《纽约时报》的一篇重磅报道引发了全新的反应。

sentences.en: A trial that seemed to be on a steady and speedy path to certain acquittal has been hit by a seismic shock.
sentences.zh: 一场原本似乎正稳步快速走向确定无罪判决的审判，受到了地震般的冲击。

sentences.en: Startling new report could upend the impeachment trial.
sentences.zh: 令人震惊的新报道可能会颠覆弹劾审判。

sentences.en: According to the New York Times...
sentences.zh: 据《纽约时报》报道……

sentences.en: So what did you learn was actually in this book?
sentences.zh: 那么你们了解到这本书里到底写了什么？

sentences.en: The biggest thing that is in there is that Bolton writes about a conversation that he claims to have had with President Trump in August of 2019,
sentences.zh: 其中最重要的一点是，博尔顿写到了他声称在2019年8月与特朗普总统进行的一次谈话，

sentences.en: where he pushed the issue of this withheld military aid with the president.
sentences.zh: 在那次谈话中，他向总统提出了扣留军事援助的问题。

sentences.en: And the president suggested he didn't want to end the aid freeze until Ukraine turned over materials that he wanted in connection with investigations into Democrats who he thought had harmed him in 2016.
sentences.zh: 总统表示，在乌克兰交出他想要的、与调查那些他认为在2016年伤害过他的民主党人有关的材料之前，他不想结束援助冻结。

sentences.en: So Bolton is having a conversation, he recounts in this book, with President Trump, in which Bolton says,
sentences.zh: 所以博尔顿在书中叙述了他与特朗普总统的谈话，博尔顿说，

sentences.en: Hey, Mr. President, I want to talk about this financial freeze on military aid to Ukraine, presumably in the context of Bolton wanting to end it.
sentences.zh: “嘿，总统先生，我想谈谈对乌克兰的军事援助冻结问题”，大概是在博尔顿想要结束冻结的背景下。

sentences.en: Bolton pushed this conversation with the president because he, along with the Secretary of State and the Secretary of Defense,
sentences.zh: 博尔顿向总统提出这次谈话，是因为他与国务卿和国防部长一起，

sentences.en: had been trying to get the president for weeks to end the freeze and turn the aid over, arguing that it was necessary for Ukraine to defend itself against Russia.
sentences.zh: 几周来一直试图让总统结束冻结并移交援助，理由是这对乌克兰抵御俄罗斯至关重要。

sentences.en: And so Bolton raised this issue to test where the president was.
sentences.zh: 所以博尔顿提出了这个问题来测试总统的态度。

sentences.en: And the president met him back by saying he didn't want to end this freeze until materials that he wanted were turned over in relation to investigations into Democrats he thought had damaged him.
sentences.zh: 总统回应说，在与调查那些他认为伤害过他的民主党人有关的材料被交出之前，他不想结束这种冻结。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Democrats including Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 包括乔·拜登在内的民主党人。

sentences.en: Democrats including Joe Biden and his son Hunter Biden.
sentences.zh: 包括乔·拜登和他的儿子亨特·拜登在内的民主党人。

sentences.en: So Bolton is confirming in this account that President Trump articulated, correct me if I'm wrong,
sentences.zh: 所以博尔顿在这一叙述中证实了特朗普总统明确表达了——如果我说错了请纠正我——

sentences.en: a clear quid pro quo that explained why he was holding up the security aid to Ukraine, that it was in return for Ukraine investigating his Democratic rivals like Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 一个清晰的“利益交换”，解释了他为什么要扣留对乌克兰的安全援助，即这是为了换取乌克兰调查他的民主党竞争对手，如乔·拜登。

sentences.en: And that, of course, is the central claim of the articles of impeachment.
sentences.zh: 而这当然是弹劾条款的核心主张。

sentences.en: And what Bolton seems to be saying here is that that central claim is accurate.
sentences.zh: 博尔顿在这里似乎是在说，那个核心主张是准确的。

sentences.en: And there's now a firsthand account of it from the mouth of the president himself.
sentences.zh: 现在有了来自总统本人之口的第一手叙述。

sentences.en: But you say confirms this is the first time that we're hearing anyone say this.
sentences.zh: 但你说证实了这一点，这是我们第一次听到有人这么说。

sentences.en: This is the first time that someone who was in the room who spoke directly to the president says,
sentences.zh: 这是第一次有在场的人、直接与总统交谈过的人说，

sentences.en: yeah, the president didn't want to release the money until he got the fruits of the investigations.
sentences.zh: “是的，总统在得到调查结果之前不想发放这笔钱”。

sentences.en: This is new ground.
sentences.zh: 这是一个新的领域。

sentences.en: And it's significant because the president's lawyers have time and time again argued on the Senate floor
sentences.zh: 这很重要，因为总统的律师曾一次又一次地在参议院辩论厅里辩称

sentences.en: that there was no connection between security assistance and investigations.
sentences.zh: 安全援助与调查之间没有任何联系。

sentences.en: That the aid and the investigations were not linked.
sentences.zh: 援助和调查并没有关联。

sentences.en: The pause on security assistance was distinct and unrelated to investigations.
sentences.zh: 暂停安全援助是独立事件，与调查无关。

sentences.en: So this directly contradicts the way the president's own lawyers talk about the impeachment.
sentences.zh: 所以这直接反驳了总统自己的律师谈论弹劾案的方式。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Or at least it undercuts their main argument, which is that there was not a connection between what the president wanted and releasing this aid.
sentences.zh: 或者至少削弱了他们的主要论点，即总统想要的东西与发放这笔援助之间没有联系。

sentences.en: Am I right, Mike and Maggie, that this is as close to a smoking gun as it gets in a case like this?
sentences.zh: 迈克和玛吉，我说的对吗？这是否已接近此类案件中所谓的“确凿证据”了？

sentences.en: Maybe.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。

sentences.en: But throughout the Trump presidency, we've learned similarly explosive disclosures.
sentences.zh: 但在整个特朗普总统任期内，我们已经了解到类似爆炸性的披露。

sentences.en: And the president has been able to weather them politically.
sentences.zh: 而总统在政治上总能安然度过。

sentences.en: So, yeah, in a normal time, would the news of the president's most recent national security advisor
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，在正常时期，总统最新的国家安全顾问

sentences.en: directly implicating him in a question that is at the center of an impeachment hearing be a smoking gun?
sentences.zh: 直接将他卷入弹劾听证会核心问题的消息，会是确凿证据吗？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: But Trump has shown an ability to endure things like this that gives me reticence to say,
sentences.zh: 但特朗普表现出一种承受此类事件的能力，这让我不敢说

sentences.en: yeah, that's a smoking gun, because when you say smoking gun, built into that is an assumption that the end would be near.
sentences.zh: “是的，这就是确凿证据”，因为当你提到确凿证据时，其中隐含着一种假设，即终局将近。

sentences.en: I'm with Mike on that.
sentences.zh: 我同意迈克的看法。

sentences.en: I think that we are a ways away from knowing what this means.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们距离了解这意味着什么还有一段距离。

sentences.en: And as our colleague Peter Baker wrote today, it could end up being like when the Access Hollywood tape came out in 2016 in the campaign.
sentences.zh: 正如我们的同事彼得·贝克今天所写，这最终可能就像2016年竞选期间《好莱坞报道》录音带曝光时那样。

sentences.en: And the big prediction was that this was going to be the end of Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 当时人们大肆预测这将是唐纳德·特朗普的末日。

sentences.en: This was going to be the end of his campaign and obviously did not go that way.
sentences.zh: 这将是他竞选的终点，但显然事情并没有那样发展。

sentences.en: So we just don't know yet.
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在还不得而知。

sentences.en: Well, what has been the reaction to this reporting, especially in the Senate where the trial is well underway and where the question of calling witnesses is very much still alive?
sentences.zh: 那么，对于这篇报道的反应如何，特别是在审判正如火如荼进行、且是否传唤证人的问题依然悬而未决的参议院？

sentences.en: So we're coming into the homestretch of the trial and the question of whether Bolton will testify has still not been resolved.
sentences.zh: 审判已进入最后冲刺阶段，博尔顿是否会作证的问题仍未解决。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The story comes out and there's increased pressure on Senate Republicans, those moderate ones, who may be willing to go along with the Democrats.
sentences.zh: 报道一出，参议院共和党人，尤其是那些可能愿意与民主党人合作的温和派，压力倍增。

sentences.en: How much does this story move them?
sentences.zh: 这篇报道对他们有多大影响？

sentences.en: And Maggie, what's the answer?
sentences.zh: 玛吉，答案是什么？

sentences.en: So far, we are seeing the same moderates who have said they want witnesses before still say they want to hear from Bolton.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，我们看到的还是那些之前就表示希望传唤证人的温和派，他们依然表示想听听博尔顿的说法。

sentences.en: So that's Mitt Romney.
sentences.zh: 也就是米特·罗姆尼。

sentences.en: Four of you need to say yes.
sentences.zh: 你们需要四个人投赞成票。

sentences.en: Do you think there are four votes?
sentences.zh: 你认为会有四票吗？

sentences.en: I think it's increasingly likely that other Republicans will join those of us who think we should hear from John Bolton.
sentences.zh: 我认为其他共和党人加入我们这些认为应该听取约翰·博尔顿证词的人的可能性越来越大。

sentences.en: And whether there are other witnesses and documents, well, that's another matter.
sentences.zh: 至于是否会有其他证人和文件，那是另一回事了。

sentences.en: But I think John Bolton's relevance to our decision has become increasingly clear.
sentences.zh: 但我认为约翰·博尔顿对我们决策的相关性已变得越来越清晰。

sentences.en: Susan Collins of Maine is another person who has said this is another factor that points to why there should be witnesses.
sentences.zh: 缅因州的苏珊·柯林斯是另一位表示这是支持传唤证人的又一因素的人。

sentences.en: But two other possible votes for witnesses.
sentences.zh: 但还有另外两张可能的赞成票。

sentences.en: One is Lisa Murkowski of Alaska.
sentences.zh: 一位是阿拉斯加州的丽莎·穆尔科斯基。

sentences.en: Another is Lamar Alexander, who the White House is watching very closely to see what he'll do.
sentences.zh: 另一位是拉马尔·亚历山大，白宫正密切关注他的动向。

sentences.en: They have been more circumspect about whether they think our story changes anything.
sentences.zh: 对于我们的报道是否改变了什么，他们表现得更为谨慎。

sentences.en: And so far, Senate Majority Leader Mitch McConnell is trying to tell everybody to stay cool and just see how this plays out.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，参议院多数党领袖米奇·麦康奈尔正试图告诉所有人保持冷静，静观其变。

sentences.en: I mean, there will be people hearing this,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，人们听到这些，

sentences.en: hearing that the national security advisor to the president observed him saying something that directly implicates him in this impeachment case.
sentences.zh: 听到总统的国家安全顾问观察到他说了直接将他卷入这起弹劾案的话。

sentences.en: And we'll ask, why would any deliberative body sworn in as jurors not want to hear from that person?
sentences.zh: 大家会问，为什么任何宣誓担任陪审员的审议机构会不想听听那个人的证词呢？

sentences.en: What would be the justification for not hearing from Bolton in this moment?
sentences.zh: 在这一刻，不听取博尔顿证词的理由是什么？

sentences.en: So one thing that has come up from the senators in the last several hours is they're saying if this was so important to hear from Bolton, why didn't the House subpoena him?
sentences.zh: 过去几个小时里，参议员们提出的一个观点是，如果听取博尔顿的证词如此重要，为什么众议院不传唤他？

sentences.en: There is nothing new here that John Bolton didn't know before the House managers rested their case and stopped calling witnesses and they never chose to call John Bolton.
sentences.zh: 约翰·博尔顿在众议院控方结束陈述并停止传唤证人之前就知道这些，而他们从未选择传唤约翰·博尔顿，这并没有什么新鲜的。

sentences.en: And you're going to hear that, I think, increasingly if you don't see a move toward witnesses.
sentences.zh: 如果你看不到转向传唤证人的迹象，我想你会越来越多地听到这种说法。

sentences.en: That's going to be an argument that senators are going to point to.
sentences.zh: 这将是参议员们会指出的一个论点。

sentences.en: You missed your chance.
sentences.zh: 你们错过了机会。

sentences.en: Why are we doing your work for you?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们要替你们做这份工作？

sentences.en: That part was in the House.
sentences.zh: 那部分是在众议院发生的。

sentences.en: And at another level, the reason why these senators are not going along with calling Bolton is that Trump doesn't want that to happen.
sentences.zh: 从另一个层面来看，这些参议员不配合传唤博尔顿的原因是特朗普不希望那样发生。

sentences.en: And they have been in lockstep with Trump for most of this.
sentences.zh: 在大部分时间里，他们与特朗普保持高度一致。

sentences.en: So the justification is keep the president happy.
sentences.zh: 所以理由就是让总统高兴。

sentences.en: I think the justification is you have a lot of senators who are facing elections in their own states and the base likes Trump.
sentences.zh: 我认为理由是，许多参议员面临各自州的选举，而他们的基本盘喜欢特朗普。

sentences.en: And in some states, like Lamar Alexander's state, they want him to be loyal to Trump.
sentences.zh: 在一些州，比如拉马尔·亚历山大的州，他们希望他忠于特朗普。

sentences.en: And so those are the concerns that they're measuring is do they let themselves be looked back on in history as turning away from evidence, which some people will say they did?
sentences.zh: 所以他们衡量的是，他们是否会让自己在历史上被视为背弃证据的人——有些人会这么说？

sentences.en: Or do they say voters don't really want me casting that vote and they decide to stick with the president's desires?
sentences.zh: 还是说他们认为选民并不真的希望我投那一票，于是决定坚持总统的意愿？

sentences.en: So how has all of this actually landed inside the White House?
sentences.zh: 那么这一切在白宫内部究竟产生了什么影响？

sentences.en: Well, the White House as a whole wasn't happy about hearing about this.
sentences.zh: 嗯，白宫整体对听到这些消息并不高兴。

sentences.en: But for at least some of them,
sentences.zh: 但至少对其中一些人来说，

sentences.en: it wasn't a surprise because the White House had been given a draft of this manuscript about three and a half weeks ago from John Bolton for a standard review process to look at classified information and whether there is any in the book.
sentences.zh: 这并不令人惊讶，因为白宫在大约三周半前就收到了约翰·博尔顿这份手稿的草稿，用于标准的审查程序，以查看是否包含机密信息。

sentences.en: So that means at least some folks in the White House have had a sense of what Bolton would testify to in the impeachment investigation.
sentences.zh: 这意味着白宫里至少有些人已经预感到博尔顿会在弹劾调查中作证什么内容。

sentences.en: If he testified.
sentences.zh: 如果他作证的话。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Wait, so does that mean that the president's lawyers, including those who are currently defending him in the Senate trial,
sentences.zh: 等等，那是否意味着总统的律师，包括那些目前在参议院审判中为他辩护的人，

sentences.en: that they knew what John Bolton had written and knew what John Bolton had experienced and then continued to make a case to the public that is quite contradictory to what Bolton is saying happened in this book?
sentences.zh: 他们知道约翰·博尔顿写了什么，也知道他经历了什么，然后继续向公众陈述一套与博尔顿书中描述完全矛盾的说法？

sentences.en: We don't know the extent to which the manuscript or the details about it were circulated.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道手稿或其细节流传的范围有多广。

sentences.en: But what we do know is that in the past several weeks, there has been a concerted effort by the president to stop Bolton from testifying.
sentences.zh: 但我们所知道的是，在过去几周里，总统一直在协同努力阻止博尔顿作证。

sentences.en: He's made public statements about this.
sentences.zh: 他曾就此发表过公开声明。

sentences.en: The problem with John is that it's a national security problem.
sentences.zh: 约翰的问题在于，这是一个国家安全问题。

sentences.en: You know, you can't have somebody who's at national security.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你不能让一个负责国家安全的人这样做。

sentences.en: And if you think about it, John, he knows some of my thoughts.
sentences.zh: 如果你仔细想想，约翰，他知道我的一些想法。

sentences.en: He knows what I think about leaders.
sentences.zh: 他知道我对各国领导人的看法。

sentences.en: What happens if he reveals what I think about a certain leader and it's not very positive and that I have to deal on behalf of the country.
sentences.zh: 如果他透露了我对某位领导人的看法，而这些看法不太正面，但我又必须代表国家与他打交道，那会发生什么？

sentences.en: It's going to be very hard.
sentences.zh: 那会非常困难。

sentences.en: It's going to make the job very hard.
sentences.zh: 这会让工作变得非常困难。

sentences.en: He knows other things.
sentences.zh: 他还知道其他事情。

sentences.en: And I don't know if we left on the best of the terMs.
sentences.zh: 而且我不知道我们是否是在最好的条件下分手的。

sentences.en: I would say probably not, you know.
sentences.zh: 我想大概不是，你知道的。

sentences.en: And so you don't like people testifying when they didn't leave on good terMs.
sentences.zh: 所以你不喜欢人们在分手条件不好的时候出来作证。

sentences.en: And that was due to me, not due to him.
sentences.zh: 那是我的原因，不是他的原因。

sentences.en: And so we'll see what happens.
sentences.zh: 所以我们走着瞧吧。

sentences.en: And he has said it privately to AIDS.
sentences.zh: 他私下里也对助手们说过。

sentences.en: So my final question is, if John Bolton has something to say, and it feels like he does, and the world wants to hear it, senators want to hear it,
sentences.zh: 所以我的最后一个问题是，如果约翰·博尔顿有话要说，而且感觉他确实有，全世界都想听，参议员们想听，

sentences.en: House impeachment managers want to hear it, we all want to hear it.
sentences.zh: 众议院弹劾经理们想听，我们大家都想听。

sentences.en: And it feels like he has a kind of obligation to the democratic process to say it.
sentences.zh: 而且感觉他有一种对民主进程的义务去说出来。

sentences.en: Why doesn't he just find a way to say it?
sentences.zh: 为什么他不找个方式说出来呢？

sentences.en: Go on Fox.
sentences.zh: 上福克斯新闻。

sentences.en: Go on CNN.
sentences.zh: 上CNN。

sentences.en: Have a news conference.
sentences.zh: 开个新闻发布会。

sentences.en: Why hasn't he taken any of those opportunities?
sentences.zh: 为什么他没有抓住任何这些机会？

sentences.en: It's a great question, and there's nothing preventing him from doing so.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很好的问题，没有任何东西阻止他这样做。

sentences.en: If he wanted to issue some kind of a statement or say something publicly that didn't, you know, violate executive privilege with the president, he could do that.
sentences.zh: 如果他想发表某种声明或公开说些不违反总统行政特权的话，他完全可以这样做。

sentences.en: But he has yet to do any of that, and it's not really clear why.
sentences.zh: 但他至今还没做任何这些事，原因并不清楚。

sentences.en: But you know what?
sentences.zh: 但你知道吗？

sentences.en: If John Bolton went on television right now and said everything he would testify to, unless he was subpoenaed to appear at that trial,
sentences.zh: 如果约翰·博尔顿现在上电视说出他将作证的一切，除非他被传唤到审判现场，

sentences.en: or if the comments for him were put into evidence, then it couldn't be considered by the lawmakers.
sentences.zh: 或者如果他的评论被作为证据提交，否则立法者们无法将其纳入考量。

sentences.en: This is a trial where evidence is brought forward, and if there is not enough votes to bring that evidence in,
sentences.zh: 这是一场以证据为基础的审判，如果没有足够的票数将这些证据引入，

sentences.en: then it doesn't matter whether he stands out on the highest point in town and says everything he knows.
sentences.zh: 那么他站在城里最高的地方说出他所知道的一切都无济于事。

sentences.en: It only matters whether it's entered into the record in the Senate.
sentences.zh: 重要的是这些内容是否被记录在参议院的档案中。

sentences.en: Maggie and Mike, thank you.
sentences.zh: 玛吉和迈克，谢谢你们。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thanks for having us.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我们。

sentences.en: On Monday, a lawyer for the White House, Patrick Philbin, tried to tamp down talk of calling Bolton as a witness, saying that calling such a witness would be an effort to, quote,
sentences.zh: 周一，白宫律师帕特里克·菲尔宾试图压制传唤博尔顿作为证人的讨论，称传唤此类证人将是试图，引用：

sentences.en: redo the House impeachment inquiry and would set a dangerous precedent for future impeachment trials.
sentences.zh: “重做众议院弹劾调查”，并将为未来的弹劾审判开创危险的先例。

sentences.en: The record that the House Democrats collected during that process, Philbin said, shows that the president did nothing wrong.
sentences.zh: 菲尔宾说，众议院民主党人在该过程中收集的记录显示，总统没有做错任何事。

sentences.en: In a tweet, the president denied Bolton's account of their conversation about Ukraine, writing, quote,
sentences.zh: 总统在推特上否认了博尔顿关于他们谈论乌克兰的说法，写道，引用：

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: On Monday, as it sought to contain the coronavirus,
sentences.zh: 周一，在试图遏制冠状病毒之际，

sentences.en: the Chinese government broadened its quarantine to more than 50 million people and said that it would spend at least $9 billion to stop the outbreak.
sentences.zh: 中国政府将隔离范围扩大到超过5000万人，并表示将投入至少90亿美元来阻止疫情爆发。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: government said it was organizing an evacuation of American citizens out of the epicenter of the illness in Wuhan.
sentences.zh: 政府表示正在组织撤离武汉疫情中心的美国公民。

sentences.en: And the pharmaceutical company Johnson & Johnson said it would begin developing a potential vaccine against the virus, joining several government agencies seeking to do the same.
sentences.zh: 制药公司强生表示将开始研发针对该病毒的潜在疫苗，加入到寻求同样目标的几个政府机构行列中。

sentences.en: As of Monday night, the coronavirus had infected nearly 3,000 people and killed more than 80.
sentences.zh: 截至周一晚间，冠状病毒已感染近3000人，死亡超过80人。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》，我们正准备迎接节假日的客人。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人感到宾至如归的建议。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要完全遮光才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为那是非常具体的事情。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶的人？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何播客平台上收听《Wirecutter秀》。
